description: This file manages the scheduling, execution, and lifecycle of cron jobs within a system, including timer management, job execution with timeout handling, error processing, and startup catch-up logic.

methods.name: executeJobCoreWithTimeout
methods.description: Runs a cron job with a timeout, aborting if execution exceeds the job's configured timeout.

methods.name: resolveRunConcurrency
methods.description: Determines the maximum number of concurrent cron jobs based on configuration.

methods.name: timeoutErrorMessage
methods.description: Returns the error message used when a cron job times out.

methods.name: isAbortError
methods.description: Checks if an error is an abort error caused by timeout.

methods.name: normalizeCronRunErrorText
methods.description: Normalizes error objects or strings into a consistent error message string.

methods.name: createCronTaskRunId
methods.description: Generates a unique task run ID for a cron job based on job ID and start time.

methods.name: tryCreateCronTaskRun
methods.description: Attempts to create a task run record for a cron job, returning the run ID or undefined on failure.

methods.name: tryFinishCronTaskRun
methods.description: Marks a cron task run as completed or failed based on the outcome.

methods.name: errorBackoffMs
methods.description: Calculates exponential backoff delay based on consecutive errors.

methods.name: isTransientCronError
methods.description: Determines if an error is transient and eligible for retries based on patterns and configuration.

methods.name: resolveRetryConfig
methods.description: Resolves retry configuration including max attempts and backoff schedule.

methods.name: resolveDeliveryStatus
methods.description: Determines the delivery status of a cron job based on delivery outcome.

methods.name: normalizeCronMessageChannel
methods.description: Normalizes input into a valid CronMessageChannel string.

methods.name: normalizeTo
methods.description: Normalizes input into a trimmed string or undefined.

methods.name: clampPositiveInt
methods.description: Clamps a value to a positive integer fallback.

methods.name: clampNonNegativeInt
methods.description: Clamps a value to a non-negative integer fallback.

methods.name: resolveFailureAlert
methods.description: Resolves the configuration for failure alerts for a specific job.

methods.name: emitFailureAlert
methods.description: Sends or enqueues a failure alert for a cron job.

methods.name: applyJobResult
methods.description: Updates job state based on execution result, handles backoff, auto-disable, and next run calculation.

methods.name: applyOutcomeToStoredJob
methods.description: Applies execution outcome to the stored job and updates its state.

methods.name: armTimer
methods.description: Sets or resets the main timer for the next scheduled job execution.

methods.name: armRunningRecheckTimer
methods.description: Sets a timer to recheck running jobs periodically.

methods.name: onTimer
methods.description: Main timer callback that finds due jobs, executes them, and manages session reaping.

methods.name: isRunnableJob
methods.description: Determines if a job is ready to run based on its state and schedule.

methods.name: isErrorBackoffPending
methods.description: Checks if a job is still in an error backoff window.

methods.name: collectRunnableJobs
methods.description: Collects all jobs that are ready to run at the current time.

methods.name: runMissedJobs
methods.description: Runs jobs that were missed during startup or restart.

methods.name: planStartupCatchup
methods.description: Plans which missed jobs to run immediately after startup.

methods.name: executeStartupCatchupPlan
methods.description: Executes the plan for missed jobs after startup.

methods.name: runStartupCatchupCandidate
methods.description: Runs an individual missed job during startup catch-up.

methods.name: applyStartupCatchupOutcomes
methods.description: Applies outcomes of startup catch-up runs to the job store.

methods.name: runDueJobs
methods.description: Runs all jobs that are due at the current time.

methods.name: executeJob
methods.description: Executes a specific job, updating its state and handling completion.

methods.name: emitJobFinished
methods.description: Emits an event indicating a job has finished execution.

methods.name: wake
methods.description: Wakes the scheduler, optionally requesting an immediate heartbeat.

methods.name: stopTimer
methods.description: Stops the current timer.

methods.name: emit
methods.description: Emits an event to the system's event handler.
